label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Held at 331 across every UNGRD balance since Aug 25, including the Sept 3, 06:30 report — the toll has now stayed flat for over a week.

label: Injured
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 3, 06:30 balance put injured at 4,519, up from the Colombian Presidency's Aug 30 figure of 4,497.

label: Missing
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 3, 06:30 balance narrowed missing to 122 — down from the 152 figure the presidency and Medicina Legal had converged on Aug 29–30 — as identification work continues.

label: Families Affected
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 3, 06:30 balance recorded 466,606 people affected across 293,743 families in 498 municipios and 16 departments — a sharp jump in family count from the presidency's Aug 30 figure of 213,400 families, even though the people-affected total is roughly flat.

label: Structures Destroyed
contestNote: UNGRD's Sept 3, 06:30 balance cited 36,336 homes destroyed and 201,010 damaged, up from the presidency's Aug 30 figure of 35,987 destroyed / 198,601 damaged, across 498 municipios (from 497).

label: Departments Affected
contestNote: Holding at 16 departments in UNGRD's Sept 3 balance, but the municipio count widened again to 498 (from 497 on Aug 30); which department was added beyond Decree 1261's original 15 remains unclarified.

label: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
contestNote: A joint UNDP-UNGRD damage assessment published Aug 30 put total direct physical damage at COP 42.1 trillion (2.3% of GDP) — COP 37.4T in housing and COP 4.8T in health, education and community infrastructure — up from the government's earlier COP 30T preliminary estimate. Independent estimates still range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP).

label: Aftershocks Recorded
contestNote: New shallow aftershocks continue near the epicentral zone — a three-day Istmina sequence peaking at M4.3 on Sept 3, followed by M3.1 and M2.9 tremors near Istmina on Sept 5 — though SGC has not published an updated running total since 325+ (Aug 17).
